ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (24) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Богатство» (bogatstvo, 'wealth') and «грабеж/ограбление» (grabyozh/ograblenie, 'robbery/robbing') are kept literal and repeated as in the source; Solomon's saying is translated from Tolstoy's Russian, not from an English Bible. Attributions follow the print: «Иоанн Златоуст» (Ioann Zlatoust, 'John Chrysostom'), «Джон Рёскин» (Dzhon Ryoskin, 'John Ruskin'), «С английского» (s angliyskogo, 'From the English'), and «Кант» without a final period as printed.
